items.content_text: Polygonia, JEZUS X, Brenda., Aguirre and more will help ring in a decade this weekend.

items.title: Time Warp announces first Los Angeles edition
items.content_text: The two-day warehouse festival will host Juliana Huxtable, Richie Hawtin, Ben Klock, Tiga and more.

items.title: Porter Robinson announces remix album, SMILE! :D plus+, with Frost Children, G Jones
items.content_text: A version of "Perfect Pinterest Garden" featuring underscores and Ninajirachi is out now.

items.title: This week's top stories: RIP Sway, RA25 lineups, Richie Hawtin fansite
items.content_text: We round up five key stories from the last few days.

items.title: Mix Of The Day: Doula
items.content_text: Head spinning psychedelia.

items.title: New Melburne festival ORTA reveals lineup for debut edition
items.content_text: Cousin, Pugilist and Sofay will play the one-day event at Heide Museum of Modern Art.

items.title: Charli xcx - Music, Fashion, Film
items.content_text: The British pop star says the dance floor is dead. Her eighth album swaps euphoria for guitar crunch and diary-page candour—bracing, if rarely classic.

items.title: Fauzia - I Was Here For A Moment
items.content_text: One of the UK's most versatile producers turns in a record of densely layered pop pulsing with hazy memories of the club.

items.title: Mix Of The Day: Xiaolaba
items.content_text: Quirky library music meets avant-garde jazz.

items.title: Mix Of The Day: Adam BFD
items.content_text: Catchy UKG and club stompers.

items.title: Mix Of The Day: Khyrie
items.content_text: Dense ambient, brooding half-time and barrelling techno.

items.title: Richie Hawtin signs to Dixon's TS Agency
items.content_text: "Our scene was built by independent artists supporting one another, and I still believe that's where its future lies," Hawtin said.
